prs.title: fix(server): exit when MCP client closes stdin pipe
prs.author: ElliotDrel
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: StdioServerTransport does not shut down when the host process exits and closes the stdin pipe, causing orphaned server processes. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: StdioServerTransport does not shut down when the host process exits and closes the stdin pipe, causing orphaned server processes. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2003 handles both the `end` and `close` events on stdin, which covers the full Node.js stream lifecycle (EOF signaled by `end`, stream destruction signaled by `close`). PR #1712 only wires the `end` event, so a `close`-without-`end` path (e.g. abrupt pipe destruction) would still leave the server orphaned. The one trade-off is that #1712 forwards close errors to `onerror` while #2003 silently swallows them; that difference should be reconciled when merging, but the broader event coverage of #2003 is the stronger foundation.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2003 handles both the `end` and `close` events on stdin, which covers the full Node.js stream lifecycle (EOF signaled by `end`, stream destruction signaled by `close`). PR #1712 only wires the `end` event, so a `close`-without-`end` path (e.g. abrupt pipe destruction) would still leave the server orphaned. The one trade-off is that #1712 forwards close errors to `onerror` while #2003 silently swallows them; that difference should be reconciled when merging, but the broader event coverage of #2003 is the stronger foundation.
